dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Concentrated density of solid dark pixels localized on the lower-left lateral surface. Lower density of isolated, asymmetrical low-intensity spots scattered across the upper-mid dorsal region between larger annular structures.
